- Root cause, found by changing the live DOM only, no file edits:
  - The list is a single-column grid with a 706 px track. The `truncate` author span has `white-space:nowrap`, so the spaced name becomes 544 px wide at min-content, and the grid item (the `li`, which has no min-width:0) grows the track to fit it.
  - With `truncate` removed from the author spans, scrollWidth is 669; the rest comes from my unbroken 64-character test author.
  - With `truncate` kept and `min-width:0` added on each `li`, scrollWidth is 390.
  - So the clipping needs the row (grid item) to be allowed to shrink: `min-w-0` on the `li`, or `grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)]` on the list.
- Step 2 at 1280 px: control heights are input 36, Search button 36, segmented filter 36, sort 36. The Tag select is 32 px and sits under its own "Tag" label, so it does not line up with the others; it comes from another feature and is not in this diff. (harness/evidence/F090/step-02.png)

- Horizontal overflow on /books at a phone width, caused by the uncommitted change in components/book-list.tsx (the `truncate` added to the author span).
  - To reproduce: at 390x844, add a book whose author is "Bartholomew Maximilian Featherstonehaugh-Worthington the Third of Somewhere", then open /books.
